description:
Activate Zack by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Zack dies, its persist ability and Pawn of Ulamog triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Zack from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Zack ability from step 1.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
